title: Property in Mudaliarpet Pondicherry | Houses & Plots
description: Houses and plots in Mudaliarpet, south of the town centre. Some streets hold water after heavy rain, so check drainage and documents. Book a free check.
lead: Mudaliarpet lies south of the town centre and attracts both local families and buyers who want to stay close to the coast road.

guide.label: Tell us what you need in Mudaliarpet

paras: It is a mixed area of established streets and newer houses, with easy access toward the coast road and the rest of town. Demand is mostly local families and small investors.

paras: As in other low-lying parts of the coast, ask about water standing in the street after heavy rain and where drainage goes. Then check the approval, patta and chitta, encumbrance certificate and parent documents.
